statement: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_channel_labels_20260612 AS WITH channels AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(channel_id AS STRING) AS channel_id FROM prod_tads.youtube_too.yt_sl_channels WHERE channel_id IS NOT NULL), raw_categories AS (SELECT CAST(canonical_id AS STRING) AS channel_id, topic_categories, collected_at, collected_date FROM dev_sean.default.channel_category WHERE canonical_id IS NOT NULL), latest AS (SELECT channel_id, topic_categories, collected_at, collected_date FROM (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.channel_id ORDER BY r.collected_at DESC, r.collected_date DESC) AS rn FROM raw_categories r INNER JOIN channels c ON r.channel_id = c.channel_id) WHERE rn = 1), normalized AS (SELECT c.channel_id, CASE WHEN pmod(xxhash64(concat_ws('|', c.channel_id, 'topic_taxonomy_holdout_20260612')), 100) < 80 THEN 'train' ELSE 'heldout' END AS split, l.collected_at, l.collected_date, array_distinct(filter(coalesce(l.topic_categories, CAST(array() AS ARRAY<STRING>)), x -> x IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(x)) > 0)) AS topic_category_urls FROM channels c LEFT JOIN latest l ON c.channel_id = l.channel_id), with_slugs AS (SELECT *, transform(topic_category_urls, x -> CASE WHEN x RLIKE '/wiki/' THEN regexp_replace(regexp_extract(x, '/wiki/(.*)$', 1), '%20', '_') ELSE x END) AS topic_categories FROM normalized) SELECT channel_id, split, collected_at, collected_date, topic_category_urls, topic_categories, size(topic_categories) AS topic_category_count, get(topic_categories, 0) AS first_topic_category, CASE WHEN collected_at IS NULL THEN 'missing_category_row' WHEN size(topic_categories) = 0 THEN 'empty_topic_categories' ELSE 'nonempty_topic_categories' END AS category_status FROM with_slugs
